rationale: Anchors are document-scoped in YAML, so an alias in document 2 must not bind document 1's same-named anchor. The pre-fix registry was keyed by the bare anchor name across the whole file and was FIRST-wins, so this edge resolved -- at confidence 1.0, marked resolved -- to an anchor in a different document. It is now unresolved WITH A REASON, because 'declared in another document' and 'never declared' are different findings and only one is a defect.
